title: permission-mode configuration
description: Declarative permission modes for the pi coding agent. Global config has full authority; project config (.pi/permission-mode.json) is tighten-only.

$comment.description: Free-form note, ignored by the loader. /permission init writes the copy's provenance here.

acknowledgeDefaults.description: Extension version whose stock defaults you reviewed this file against. Silences 'outdated default' warnings until the shipped defaults change again. Global config only.

defaultMode.description: Name of the mode a new session starts in.

cycleOrder.description: Order modes are cycled with alt+m; also the display order.

sandbox.description: The shared OS-sandbox profile (allowWrite / denyRead / network / …). Global-only authority; a project may only tighten it. `enabled`/`writable` here are the legacy defaults; the live state is the `alt+s` toggle ("off" | "on" | "strict"), which a mode may pin via `sandboxPin` (no built-in mode does).

network.description: The network boundary — an independent axis (alt+n toggles it for the session). The filter is the sandbox runtime's proxy, so it applies while the sandbox is not `off`; `free` widens the proxy's allowlist rather than removing the boundary.

askOnBlockedHost.description: Ask the user live when bash reaches a host outside the allowlist (default true). false = silent deny. Projects may set false, never true.

statusFormat.description: Footer status style: `compact` (default, a short token line such as "Auto box:on net:limit AI:inherit") or `verbose` (the spelled-out form).

modes.description: Map of mode name → mode definition.

plan.description: One-step plan approval (the Accept / Decline prompt after show_plan, the confirm on switching to the approve mode, /plan approve). Global config only.

approveMode.description: Mode to switch to when a plan is accepted. Default: edits.

approveMessage.description: User message that starts the implementing turn; {path} is replaced by the plan path. Default: The plan in `{path}` is approved. Implement it now.

classifier.description: AI safety classifier (used by modes with `classifier: true`). Global config only; reviewer settings cannot be set by a project. The model defaults to the active session model.

enabled.description: Master switch for the classifier (default true).

model.description: "current" (default) follows the active session model; otherwise a `provider/model` id resolved from the model registry.

failClosed.description: true (default): a classifier error blocks the action. false: fall back to the human prompt.

maxConsecutiveDenials.description: Offer the human prompt after this many consecutive denials (default 3; 0 disables).

maxInputChars.description: Cap on the action payload sent to the model (default 4000).

action.description: allow = pass through; ask = prompt; deny = block.

surfaceValue.description: An action, or a glob pattern→action map (last match wins; '*' is the catch-all).

sandbox.description: OS sandbox profile for the mode.

askOnBlockedHost.description: Ask the user live when bash tries a host outside the allowlist (default true). false = silent deny. Projects may set false, never true.

allowRead.description: Paths readable again inside a denyRead region (deny-then-allow). Projects may only remove entries.

path.description: Cross-cutting gate over ALL file access; a deny here overrides per-tool allows.

external_directory.description: Access to paths outside the project.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt to inject; '@plan' resolves to the dated Plan-mode prompt.

injectSandboxInfo.description: Inject the mode's sandbox boundaries (writable paths, denied reads, network allowlist) into the system prompt each turn (default true). Modes with sandbox.enabled:false never inject.

sandbox.description: Legacy per-mode sandbox override. Prefer the top-level `sandbox`; kept for backward compatibility.

sandboxPin.description: Force the sandbox state while this mode is active (overrides the `alt+s` session toggle, restored on leaving). No built-in mode ships one; the stock modes rely on the session state.

hideTools.description: Tools hidden from the model in this mode.

bypassProtectedPaths.description: Skip the .git/.env/dotfile write backstop (only trusted modes).

classifier.description: Route this mode's `ask` decisions through the AI safety classifier instead of the human prompt (see the top-level `classifier` block).
